title: Project 3 · Multi-page Dashboard (Router)
summary: Simulated-auth dashboard with protected routes, nested views and lazy-loaded pages.
requirements: auth.store: { user: string | null }, login/logout actions; session in sessionStorage
Routes: /login public; /dashboard protected with children overview/billing/settings
Global guard redirects anonymous → /login?redirect=… and returns after login
Every page lazy-loaded; route meta titles drive document.title
